evals.prompt: Analyze this commitment for the buyer, Bramblewood Homes, LLC. I need the requirements checklist and the exception cure recommendations.
evals.expected_output: A DRAFT requirements checklist and DRAFT exception cure recommendations that cite every Schedule B-I and B-II item by number, quote recording references exactly, mark missing information as not shown, and cite standards only from the skill's own list.
expectations: Every Schedule B-I and B-II item appears, cited by its schedule and item number.
Document No. 2019-018833 and Volume 512, Page 77 appear exactly as written.
The spousal joinder requirement is tied to the vesting in Schedule A and cites Standard 14.90 or Chapter XIV.
No recording reference, date, amount or name appears that is not in the commitment.
Every standard number cited appears in the skill's quick reference or references/tx-exam-standards.md.
Each output carries the DRAFT disclaimer.
